tools.name: smaregi_list_stores
tools.description: List the stores (shops) of the Smaregi contract: id, code, name, address, phone. Use the ids to filter stock and transactions. GET /stores.

tools.name: smaregi_get_store
tools.description: One store by id. GET /stores/{store_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_staffs
tools.description: List staff members: id, code, name, role, e-mail. Passwords are never returned. GET /staffs.

tools.name: smaregi_get_staff
tools.description: One staff member by id. GET /staffs/{staff_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories (departments): id, code, name, parent, level. Use the ids when creating or filtering products. GET /categories.

tools.name: smaregi_get_category
tools.description: One product category by id. GET /categories/{category_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_products
tools.description: List products with id, category, code, name, price, cost and update time. Filter by category, code, group code, display flag or update time (a 31-day maximum range). GET /products.

tools.name: smaregi_get_product
tools.description: One product by id, optionally with store prices, bundled items, store assignments, reserved stock, attribute items and order settings. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (members): id, code, number, name, phone, e-mail, address. Smaregi cannot search by name, phone or e-mail: filter by customer code, member number, id range or update time, or page through. Contains shoppers' personal data. GET /customers.

tools.name: smaregi_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id, optionally with the contract's custom fields. Contains personal data. GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_stock
tools.description: List stock levels per store and product (stockAmount, reserved amount). Filter by store or product. Smaregi only lists a product once its quantity has changed at least once. An update-time filter needs both bounds (31 days at most). GET /stock.

tools.name: smaregi_list_stock_changes
tools.description: The stock change history of one product in one store: date, amount, division (sale, purchase, transfer, adjustment...). GET /stock/changes/{product_id}/{store_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_list_transactions
tools.description: List sales transactions (receipts) in a time window of at most 31 days: id, date-time, division (1 = normal sale, 2 = deposit, 3 = withdrawal...), store, terminal, customer, totals. Optionally with the line items (limit 100 then). Contains shoppers' personal data. GET /transactions.

tools.name: smaregi_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction (receipt) by its transaction id (transactionHeadId), optionally with line items, discounts and payments. Contains personal data. GET /transactions/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer (member). customerCode, firstName and lastName are required; the contract's own required-column settings may demand more. Not idempotent: calling twice with a different code creates two customers. POST /customers.

tools.name: smaregi_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one customer (only the fields you pass are changed). Overwrites the old values. PATCH /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_create_product
tools.description: WRITE: create a product. categoryId, productName and price are required. Not idempotent. POST /products.

tools.name: smaregi_update_product
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of one product (only the fields you pass are changed), for example its price or name. Overwrites the old values. PATCH /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_set_stock
tools.description: WRITE: set the absolute stock quantity of one product in one store, replacing the current quantity. Use smaregi_adjust_stock for a relative change. PATCH /stock/{product_id}.

tools.name: smaregi_adjust_stock
tools.description: WRITE: add (positive) or subtract (negative) a quantity to the stock of one product in one store. Not idempotent: a repeat applies the change again. POST /stock/{product_id}/add.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "smaregi_list_staffs" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List staff members: id, code, name, role, e-mail. Passwords are never returned. GET /staffs.
